regions.reason: Changes around the side buttons are allowed (window, running gap, insert counterbore and pull notch, face below the skin at rest).
The base outer form is the skin; its bottom cap is the open rim.

assumptions: Owner policy: ABS only; Polymaker PolyLite ABS datasheet values (cited) used for the leaf.
Owner policy: no screws except those supplied with the OP1; this carrier uses printed insert pins and a printed actuator insert.
ASSUMED stress concentration 1.5 at the R1-filleted leaf corners; outer leaf faces run flush into block and pad.

Leaves 0.6 +/- 0.05 mm: one 0.6 mm wide extrusion line from a 0.4 mm nozzle (ASSUMED slicer setting, stated with the print); an intended exception to the 1.2 mm printed-wall minimum, judged by the flexure check at the thick limit.

Carrier placement (ASSUMED): +/-0.05 mm and +/-0.18 deg about Z (0.05 mm relative pin-hole error over 15.7 mm). It moves the free pose at the lip by up to 0.19 mm, so the preload is 0.11-0.49 mm; rest and stop are on the shell and do not move with it.
Stop travel 0.5 +/- 0.1 mm from rest (ASSUMED print error of the lip and jaw faces); the worst-case click is 0.32 mm after rest.

Edge press (ASSUMED 3 N at the face edge 4.6 mm from the leaf mid-plane) twists the guide by 0.60 deg; a press at the far end yaws it by 0.32 deg; a corner press is checked as their combination (0.68 deg). Thin-limit leaves; Poisson ratio 0.35 ASSUMED.
Drawn pose = the leaves unbent (free pose). Every stroke pose is measured from the rest pose (preload in): rest, rest + 0.2 mm, the nominal stop and the stop at its + tolerance.
The pin bottoming position inside the switch is not known (ASSUMED at or above body flush); travel no longer depends on it because the shell stop ends it.

Carrier print standing on z 9.5 (block, tongue, leaves and lower pad start on the bed; leaves are vertical 0.6 mm walls). Supported faces of the button: face strip, face band and plunger underside at z 10 (about 83 mm2, 0.5 mm above the bed), pad step at z 10.5 (24 mm2), stop tab and riser at z 12 (10 mm2), spine at z 12.6 (38 mm2); supports with an ASSUMED 0.2 mm Z gap, removed with a blade; the z 10 face edges form the running gap and are deburred before fit. Bridged without support: pull-notch roof (1 mm wide, z 13.5), the 0.3 mm countersink rings at the pin-hole entries, the insert bore crown (horizontal bore, opened by drill). The lip top band rests on the face (same print). Stop jaw printed flat on its -Y face, pins and inserts upright with the head down: no supports. Shell print rim down: supports under the lower tab (z 6.2), upper tab (z 17.5), window lintel (z 18.4), roof (z 32.5) and stop post (z 11.5; keyway roof z 15, support blocker in the keyway and in the pin through holes).

Assembly: carrier in from the cavity side (+Y) between the tabs to the back-stop lip; pins pressed up from the open bottom (they drag the block and tongue up onto the upper tabs, the Z datum) with the shell supported on its top; stop jaw pushed up into the post keyway from the open bottom until it meets the slot roof; PCB and switch fitted; inserts pushed in from outside with the face held on the hard stop (the stop takes the press-in force), levered out with a pick in the pull notch.
Insert rule: fit the longest insert (0.1 mm steps) with which the switch still releases after a press to the stop, then the next shorter one: the tip rests 0.1-0.32 mm above OP.
Insert bore: printed horizontal at 1.9 mm and opened with a 1.9 mm drill by hand (ASSUMED tool); only the 1.5 mm band under the head is an interference.
Reading of 「もっと押しやすく」 used here (an interpretation for the owner to confirm): the same press force anywhere on the face (translation), a short travel to the click and a firm end stop.

PCB keep-out (ASSUMED board, modeled as pcb_slab and checked): board edge at x >= -6.0 mm for z 8-20 (the pad x -9 to -6.5 crosses the board plane); no board at x < -16 (tabs, block, tongue, pins, leaves on both sides of the plane).
design_basis.summary: Separately printed ABS carrier: the face translates on two parallel leaves, rests with a preloaded lip on the inner skin, stops on a jaw keyed into a shell post after the click, and is fixed by two vertical press-fit pins 15.7 mm apart.

flexure_checks.allowance_basis: ASSUMED half of the datasheet tensile strength (yield not published); fatigue UNKNOWN.
flexure_checks.force_basis: ASSUMED band 0.3-3 N at the deepest deflection (highest preload plus the longest stop travel) plus the largest registered switch operating force.
flexure_checks.ratio_basis: Translation: leaves, switch and press point share the same displacement (no lever).
flexure_checks.stress_concentration_basis: ASSUMED 1.5 at R1-filleted corners joined over the full leaf width.

functions.F1_transmit_force: Transmit thumb force from the skin piece into the button.
functions.F2_guide_button: Guide the face on two parallel leaves; hold it at rest with a lip on the inner skin (preloaded).
functions.F3_actuate_switch: Press the switch pin with a printed insert chosen against the fitted switch.
functions.F4_restore_button: Return the face with the elastic leaves (no separate spring).
functions.F5_limit_overtravel: A stop jaw keyed into a shell post stops the far-end tab 0.5 +/- 0.1 mm after rest (after the worst-case click); thumb and insert press-in forces go into the shell.
functions.F6_connect_shell: Fix the carrier with two vertical press-fit pins (block and tongue) between two shell tabs; keep the outer skin outside the window.

protected_constraints: Outer skin outside the side-button region is not changed (checked against the base skin).
Owner policy: ABS only; no screws except those supplied with the OP1.
title: Side button test subject, revision 18 (parallel-leaf ABS carrier, rest lip on the skin, shell hard stop, two pins 15.7 mm apart)
unverified_requirements: 押しやすさ: 平行移動のため面のどこを押しても同じ力。この読み方はオーナー確認待ちの解釈。実機の押下感・クリック感は未試験。

Press force: the leaves add 0.08-0.53 N to the fitted switch operating force at the click (registered maxima up to 1.47 N; minima not published) and up to 0.72 N at the stop (thin/thick leaf limits and the preload range).

Switch profiles (insert rule and stop from datasheets): zippy_df_pin: pass (past OP at the stop 0.08-0.50 mm vs guaranteed OT 0.20: UNKNOWN (beyond the guaranteed minimum; no rating published); pin may bottom first: yes (tolerance corner: the switch takes the force there; bottoming rating UNKNOWN)); omron_d2f_pin: pass (past OP at the stop 0.08-0.50 mm vs guaranteed OT 0.25: UNKNOWN (beyond the guaranteed minimum; no rating published); pin may bottom first: yes (tolerance corner: the switch takes the force there; bottoming rating UNKNOWN)); huano_mouse_generic: unverified (missing operating_position, movement_differential, plunger_width, overtravel); kailh_gm20: unverified (missing operating_position, movement_differential, body_height, plunger_width, body_length, body_width, overtravel).
Leaves: beam theory only (guided small deflection, rigid root, typical datasheet values, ASSUMED stress concentration and Poisson ratio); creep and fatigue UNKNOWN; creep would lower the preload.

Overtravel past OP at the stop can exceed the guaranteed minimum for some inserts; no maker publishes a rating beyond it (UNKNOWN). In a tolerance corner the pin may bottom before the stop; bottoming rating UNKNOWN.

Insert retention: the outward load is the switch pin force (up to 1.47 N at the stop; the thumb force goes into the stop). Band retention in printed ABS is UNKNOWN: first-article test = pull-out force >= 3 N with a gram gauge before the insert rule is used.
Rest lip preload, pin retention and the carrier placement tolerance are ASSUMED, not measured; first article: feeler-gauge the face-to-skin step at both ends and the stop travel.
PCB plane is ASSUMED; the real board and shell were not measured. OP1-supplied screws are not used by this carrier.
Wall checks are sampled minima of the stated parts, not a proof of minimum wall or of strength. Placement corners are rigid corners only.
verification_plan: Pair overlap and bounds; declared press fits (pins in tabs, block and tongue; insert band; rest lip preload on the skin).
Rest: outward motion blocked by the lip; inward motion blocked by the stop jaw by 1.20 mm from the free pose.

Press from rest to the stop at its + tolerance (0.90 mm from the free pose): face, insert and pad clear of the shell and the PCB by at least 0.15 / 0.30 mm at the nominal and the carrier-placement corners; the lip leaves the skin; the insert clears the switch body to the nominal stop.
Twist, yaw and corner press at rest + 0.2 mm and at the stop + tolerance: face clear of the shell by at least 0.15 mm.
Carrier insertion between the tabs to the back-stop lip (before the stop jaw); pin and stop-jaw approach from the open bottom (approach only: the seated pose is the declared press fit).

Leaves: guided-beam stiffness (two leaves), force with the largest registered switch force, root stress with stress concentration at the deepest deflection (1.09 mm: highest preload plus the longest stop travel) and at the thick limit.
Outer form outside the side-button region matches the base skin; sampled printed walls of shell, button and carrier block.
